narrative.overview: Jamval is a practical field-operations interface: calm enough for financial review, direct enough to use in a client store, and structured so the next action is obvious at a glance. Its personality is simples, prático e confiável.
keyCharacteristics: One operational step visible at a time

rules.name: The One Clear Action Rule
rules.body: Primary actions must look unmistakably actionable.

rules.name: The Useful Text Rule
rules.body: Every sentence must help the operator decide, enter, verify, or act.

rules.name: The Quiet Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use one surface boundary at a time; avoid nested cards as the default structure.

dos: Do make the next operational action visually prominent and label it with a direct verb.
Do keep copy short, concrete, and in Brazilian Portuguese.
Do preserve generous touch targets and fast numeric entry on mobile.
Do use one clear card per purpose.
donts: Don't create cards inside cards as the default organization pattern.
Don't fill cards with generic explanatory text.
Don't hide important actions behind subtle links or ambiguous icons.
Don't replace a simple flow with a dense all-at-once form.
